title.zh: AI 时代的个人信息系统
title.en: Personal Information Systems in the AI Era

summary.zh: 一场面向金融与科技从业者的分享：从真实问题出发，展示个人信息系统如何把捕捉、知识库、Agent、项目孵化和安全边界连成工作流。
summary.en: A talk for finance and technology professionals, showing how capture, knowledge bases, agents, project incubation, and safety boundaries can form a working personal information system.

title.zh: 十年睡眠记录：视觉随笔

summary.zh: 把长期睡眠记录整理成一篇关于节律、身体和生活变化的视觉随笔。
summary.en: A visual essay that turns long-term sleep records into a story about rhythm, body, and life changes.
